passages.text:
[opaque block] Google Vault - Re: Great talking to you
Re: Great talking to you
[contact omitted] Vera Zakem Thursday, July 14, 2022 at 3:42:56 PM Eastern Daylight Time
To: [opaque block] [contact omitted] Danny Rogers
Cc: [contact omitted] Johnny Walsh, [opaque block] [contact omitted] Clare Melford
Thanks Danny and Clare!
Nice to meet you and thanks so much for the materials!
We're looking forward to receiving the concept note!
Vera
On Thu, Jul 14, 2022 at 3:06 PM Danny Rogers < [opaque block] disinformationindex.org> wrote:
Thanks, Johnny and Vera, for your time and thoughtful questions and discussion today. We'll put together a concept note
focused on the countries you outlined, so thank you for the list. In the meantime, here are a few background items we
The PBS NewsHour Clip: [link omitted] omitted]/
A great NYT piece about the role of algorithms in spreading extremism: [link omitted]
technology/alt-right-youtube-algorithm.html
My Time Magazine piece from last year on policy responses: [link omitted]
Additionally, here is a map of our current and emerging coverage. We're always eager for opportunities to fill in more of
this map.
l've also attached three example Media Market Reports that demonstrate the kinds of final products we release - in
addition to launch events - in various countries. I hope this gives you all a more in-depth picture of what we do. We'll be
in touch with a concept note soon, and thanks again,
Danny
On Jul 14, 2022, at 12:05 PM, Johnny Walsh <[contact omitted]> wrote:
Danny and Clare - it was a pleasure; thank you for the time, and for your patience with this luddite. Here
are the 10 countries we particularly have in mind as homes to promising democratic openings, that need
help before they backslide as so many others have in the past. Each has its strengths and weaknesses,
and there are other countries one could reasonably include here,but we'd love to hear your reactions, and
better yet a one-pager on whether/how we might collaborate to help them. Looking forward to talking again!
Zambia
